## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

PayloadCodec — core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/transport/PayloadCodec.kt

## Trigger

Called from WearableProfileSyncTransport.send and WearableRecordedRaceTransport.send
(encode), and from ProfileSyncListenerService.onMessageReceived and
RecordedRaceListenerService.onMessageReceived (decodeProfileSync / decodeRecordedRace)
— observed

## Today

`PayloadCodec.encode` and `PayloadCodec.decodeProfileSync` / `decodeRecordedRace` are
plain (non-suspend) functions. `Serializable.toBytes()` and `ByteArray.toObject()`
build and read an `ObjectOutputStream` / `ObjectInputStream` synchronously, with no
dispatcher switch. `WearableProfileSyncTransport.send` and
`WearableRecordedRaceTransport.send` call `PayloadCodec.encode` directly inside their
own `suspend fun send`, on whatever dispatcher the caller of `send` used.
`ProfileSyncListenerService.onMessageReceived` and
`RecordedRaceListenerService.onMessageReceived` call `PayloadCodec.decodeProfileSync` /
`decodeRecordedRace` directly, synchronously, before entering their `serviceScope`
(`CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)`) — the decode call sits outside
any coroutine, on the callback's own thread.

## Expected

`PayloadCodec.encode` and `PayloadCodec.decodeProfileSync` / `decodeRecordedRace` run
their serialization work on the IO dispatcher, the way the module's other sync
boundaries do (both listener services already hold a
`CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)` for this purpose). Turning them
into suspend functions that wrap the read/write in `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)`
changes their call sites: `ProfileSyncListenerService.onMessageReceived` and
`RecordedRaceListenerService.onMessageReceived` currently call
`decodeProfileSync` / `decodeRecordedRace` synchronously, outside any coroutine
(`serviceScope.launch` is entered only afterwards, around the repository/service
call) — a suspend `decode` cannot be called from that spot as it stands, so each of
these two `onMessageReceived` methods must move its decode call inside its own
`serviceScope.launch`.
